The opening introduction heading is included as local h000; English structure begins at its first internal heading and omits this opening heading. Local heading IDs belong to this edition.
Chapter IV combines its two title lines in one HTML block; English keeps them separate. Alignment records the shared chapter heading group.
Note 124 prints [ 124] around an empty anchor. Recognize whitespace within the marker, retain sourceMarker verbatim after whitespace normalization, and extract its complete note body.

Date, signature, separators, abstract and table-of-contents text are inventoried ancillary material. The entire numbered closing/devotional text stays in its source paragraph; no prayers are removed from the original corpus.
